summary: Phase-1 Manasati (منصتي) full-stack testing complete. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASSED (auth register/login/me/logout, marketing public endpoints, sites CRUD + publish + public render + site-contact, plan limits, admin RBAC on all /api/admin/* routes, admin CRUD for customers/templates/plans/settings, audit log, contacts routing, data isolation between customers, payment_enabled=false on subscribe, domain reseller enabled=false with disabled-notice message). Frontend: register→dashboard→create site (all 4 templates in modal)→editor (add-section, save, publish)→dashboard shows published status with subdomain→public /s/{subdomain} renders all sections and contact form submission works and shows success→admin login lands on /admin→all 6 admin sub-routes load without errors and admin/contacts shows the submitted messages. The previously reported compile bug 'Cannot find module @/components/layout/PublicLayout' is FIXED — file exists at /app/frontend/src/components/layout/PublicLayout.jsx and every page loads without any pageerror/console error other than expected 401 on /api/auth/me for unauthenticated visits.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend brute-force lockout uses per-IP+email identifier which is good, but does not clear lockout after 15 min unless lockout expires naturally (locked_until check works, but the record still has count>=5). Consider resetting count after unlock window to avoid immediate re-lock on next failure.

auth.py get_current_user returns 403 for suspended users which is fine, but /auth/refresh does not honor suspension (a suspended user could still refresh access_token). Consider checking account_status in /refresh as well.

routers/sites.py: _get_plan_limits defaults to {sites:1, pages:5, custom_domain:false} when user has no plan — this is intended free tier but is not surfaced anywhere in the API; consider adding /account/limits endpoint so the frontend can render 'reached your limit' messages proactively instead of only on 403.
public/domain/search hardcodes prices in the router — fine for phase 1 but should be moved to settings or a config collection once ResellerClub is enabled.

public/site/{subdomain} strips owner_id but still returns internal ids (page/section ids). That's OK for a builder but note that leaking template_id may allow scraping which template each site uses; consider dropping in the public payload.
sites.py update_site does not enforce plan limit `sites` (only pages). OK because sites count only checked on create.

No CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints beyond cookie SameSite=None — since JWT is httpOnly+SameSite=None+secure and CORS is restricted to the platform origin with allow_credentials, cross-site fetch is blocked, but any XSS on the platform origin would allow silent state changes. Consider CSRF double-submit or SameSite=Lax where possible.
Frontend /api/auth/me is called on every page load producing a 401 for unauth users — cosmetic console noise; consider a 200-with-null shape or suppressing the error log.
